description: Paper Contradiction Finder — Takes 2 to 4 papers (DOI, arXiv id, PMID or their URLs) on a shared question and answers whether their reported numbers conflict: a verdict (CONTRADICTION_FOUND / NO_CONTRADICTION_FOUND / INCONCLUSIVE) with confidence, a one-line headline, the decisive quotes side by side and a next step, then the full evidence. Fetches the best available text (ar5iv, Europe PMC full text, else abstract), extracts

claim.description: Optional claim or question to focus on; claims about it are paired first.

mode.description: full (default): one model call judges whether candidate claim pairs measure the same quantity in comparable populations. fast: no model call; only pairs with identical normalized outcome phrases are tested.

papers.description: 2 to 4 papers on a shared question, each a DOI (bare, doi: or doi.org URL), an arXiv id or arxiv.org URL, or a PMID (bare, PMID:n, or a pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov or europepmc.org URL).

name: paperContradictions
